text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Gh—...?! Baaya did?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
No, I will hear the details at the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Baaya
text_block_list.text:
Please do not worry. It is merely a fracture.
The hospitalization is just a precaution according to the doctor...

text_block_list.name: Baaya
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, Milady...! 
I am terribly sorry for causing you such trouble this time...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Please. I do not consider this trouble in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
I am just glad it is nothing too serious.
Hearing your lively voice brings me such relief.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
...Truly... thank goodness.
For now, please just rest your body.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Now then, hospitalization means—things are going to get busy.

One day, while walking through a shopping mall,
I spotted Mejiro Ardan.
Carrying heavy luggage, she seemed to be searching for something.
choice_data_list: If you're having trouble, want me to give you a hand?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
My... thank you kindly
for your thoughtfulness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
In that case... do you happen to know of any shops around here
that carry a wide variety of pillows?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
...And so that is the situation.
If a pillow does not suit one's body,
it can cause discomfort instead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Even if it is only a brief hospital stay, I want Baaya
to be as comfortable as possible.
choice_data_list: If that's the case, let me help.

text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up helping
Mejiro Ardan with her shopping.
choice_data_list: What are you looking for next?
What are you looking for next?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
I am looking for pajamas.
A front-buttoning, gauze fabric pair
is much easier to manage during a hospital stay.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Now then, as for snacks Baaya might enjoy—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Little joys like these
are needed most during difficult times.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Because they provide the vitality
needed to overcome hardships.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
...I am merely returning the kindness
that Baaya has shown me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
You see, I spent a long time in hospitals...
And during that time,
Baaya took care of me so very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Now that Baaya is the one in need...
If that is so—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
This time, I want to do everything in my power
for Baaya's sake.

text_block_list.name: Baaya
text_block_list.text:
My, to prepare absolutely everything for me...
I do not know how I could ever thank you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, there is no need for thanks.
After all the time we have shared together, Baaya.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Now then, if there is anything at all you desire,
please just say the word.
I will run and bring it to you right away!

text_block_list.name: Baaya
text_block_list.text:
My, how reassuring.
I am truly humbled...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
...Baaya.
Please get well soon.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, thank you very much
for helping me today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
...Nursing someone in sickness
is such hard work, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Baaya did this for me for so many years...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
I want to... repay her kindness
even more.
